desc: Spend more time enjoying the things you love to do and less time worrying with the confidence of knowing you can carry your SABRE safety whistle wherever you go. SABRE's Emergency Safety Whistle can help alert those around you if you're in danger. The whistle gets as loud as 120dB and can be heard up to 750-feet (229-meters) away, helping you call for help in an emergency. Waterproof and corrosion-resistant, this whistle has a double tube design with no internal parts to break or jam, allowing it to last longer for continuous use. The emergency safety whistle features a key ring and a detachable lanyard that allows you to carry it hands-free. Attach the whistle to your bag, backpack, or purse with the included carabiner clip.
